import pickle
import pytest

import jinja2.filters


def test_issue_1612_async_variant_pickleable():
    """
    Filters decorated with @async_variant should be pickleable.
    """
    # The do_first filter is decorated with @async_variant
    # and was specifically mentioned in the bug report.
    # The bug report states that jinja2.filters.do_first.__name__
    # is 'sync_do_first' instead of 'do_first'.
    # This incorrect __name__ prevents pickling.

    # This assertion directly checks the __name__ attribute, which is
    # the root cause described in the bug report.
    # The test should fail if the __name__ is 'sync_do_first'
    # and pass if it's correctly 'do_first'.
    assert jinja2.filters.do_first.__name__ == "do_first"

    # If the __name__ is correct, then pickling should succeed.
    # This part of the test will only be reached if the above assertion passes.
    # If the bug is fixed, this should now work without PicklingError.
    pickled_filter = pickle.dumps(jinja2.filters.do_first)
    unpickled_filter = pickle.loads(pickled_filter)

    assert unpickled_filter.__name__ == "do_first"
    assert unpickled_filter.__qualname__ == "do_first"
    assert unpickled_filter.__module__ == jinja2.filters.do_first.__module__
